reveal_en: The Cosmic Microwave Background is the universe's oldest light. It's the afterglow from just 380,000 years post-Big Bang.
reveal_zh: 宇宙微波背景辐射是宇宙最古老的光。它是大爆炸后38万年的余晖。
meaning_en: This faint whisper reveals our cosmic origin story, connecting us directly to the universe's very first breath.
meaning_zh: 这微弱的耳语揭示了我们的宇宙起源故事，将我们与宇宙的初生紧密连接。

visual.theme: Ancient starlight, infinite expanse, deep time.
visual.color: Deep cosmic indigo fading into faint warm gold.
visual.motion: Slow, gentle pulse of shimmering, distant light.
